description: This file contains PHP code for managing campaign subscriptions within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes logic for handling user subscriptions and unsubscriptions, constructing selection lists, displaying templates, and processing subscription data.

methods.name: constructDDSubscriptionList
methods.description: Constructs a drag-and-drop multiselect list of subscribed and unsubscribed campaign lists for display.

methods.name: printOriginalValues
methods.description: Builds string representations of original subscription and unsubscription lists for comparison.

methods.name: manageSubscriptions
methods.description: Handles the process of subscribing and unsubscribing users based on form input, comparing current and original subscription states.
